photos.desc: Flower (crab) spider - Misumena vatia, female. Taken in Mannheim-Vogelstang, Baden-Württemberg, Germany.

Misumena vatia. This species of spider has a very pronounced sexual dimorphism in size and color. Males 4 mm long, and females up to 10 mm. The male cephalothorax blackish, abdomen from white to yello
